ns2:section.sectionText: VOCAL MUSIC IN THE AFRICAN-AMERICAN CONTEXT, 3 hours. Surveys the vocal music of African-Americans from the solo song to the gospel chorus. Vocal technique for jazz, R & B, and gospel music will be discussed, with particular attention given to text delivery, improvisation, and the extended use of the chest voice. As the course progresses, students will be asked to develop some performing and listening experience, to conduct scholarly research on the musical culture, and ultimately to design lessons to introduce selected repertoire from the cultural experience. In class together students will explore samples of songs that demonstrate African-American vocal music performance practice, and develop individual vocal technique through group vocal instruction. The course will include a lecture and lab component. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
